jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. jobs.description: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. What you'll be doing Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them. Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. jobs.title: (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer – Power, Harness Design & EMC (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer (m/f/d), you own the electrical backbone of our robots, from industrial manipulators to our bimanual platform Alfie. In this key role, you are responsible for the complete electrical system of a robot, not one section of it. You define the power, grounding and shielding concepts, engineer the wire harnesses through moving joints, and take them from first prototype to series supply. If you come from automotive Bordnetz development, you will find familiar work at a very different pace: concepts turn into running prototypes within weeks, and your decisions go straight into products at our customers. Your Responsibilities Own the electrical system architecture of our robots: power distribution concept, load distribution, fusing (Absicherung), wire cross-section sizing and data signal integrity. Define grounding/earthing and shielding concepts (Versorgungs- und Massekonzepte) and design for EMC from the first concept onwards. Plan and support EMC pre-compliance and certification testing, analyse findings and implement robust fixes. Specify wire harnesses, connectors, contacts and cables, and create wiring diagrams (Kabelschaltpläne), harness drawings and BOMs that suppliers can produce from directly. Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering. Work closely with our electronics team on interfaces, connectors, power distribution boards and safety circuits. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Designer
jobs.description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to take ownership of designs that move from early prototypes to reliable serial production? Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production. You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up. Working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and production teams, you will help ensure that our designs perform in the field and can be produced and assembled consistently. We are looking for someone who have practical manufacturing knowledge and follows a design through until it works on the assembly line. Core Responsibilities Develop and refine 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings, with a strong focus on injection-molded plastic parts. Take designs from functional prototypes through design release, tooling, initial production runs, and serial production.
